## E0118 never fires: an inherent impl of a type parameter, projection or opaque type (`impl<T> T {}`) is accepted

crates/hir-ty/src/traits.rs:466-490 `inherent_impl_coherent` lists the primitive kinds, `Adt` and `Dynamic`, then `_ => true`. That allows `TyKind::Param`, `Alias(Projection | Opaque | ..)` and the rest, so hir never pushes `IncoherentImpl` (hir/src/diagnostics.rs:2254). blaze-diagnostics' E0118 lowering (lower/incoherent_impl.rs:208-215, which already checks `as_type_param` / associated type / impl traits) is never reached, and code rustc refuses builds. rustc (`rustc_hir_analysis/src/coherence/inherent_impls.rs` `check_item`): `ty::Param(_) | ty::Alias(..) | ty::Bound | ty::Placeholder | ty::Infer` gives `InherentTyOutsideNew` / E0118 `InherentNominal`. Fix: those kinds give `false` and are not exempted by the incoherent-inherent-impls branch below. Test: blaze-diagnostics tests::items::impls::an_inherent_impl_of_a_type_parameter (empty output in round 15).
